correctness.rationale: A bimorphism preserves equality and every existing directed edge, so on each unordered pair of distinct tuple vertices the only possible strict forward move is from no edge to one of the two orientations. Conversely, coordinatewise extension in this fork gives a finite injective homomorphism, which extends to a bimorphism by the published MB-homogeneity of the generic digraph. This proves the product-poset classification for every arity. Product counting yields all formulas; the bundled checker exhaustively verifies the finite identities through four distinct vertices and the aggregate sequences through arity seven.

value.rationale: The result determines the complete finite-arity reachability geometry of a natural oligomorphic permutation monoid. It refines strong-orbit counting to an explicit ranked poset with closed formulas for ranks, comparable pairs, covers, and Möbius inversion, providing information that automorphism-orbit profiles and oligomorphicity alone do not encode.
